decision_clause: The active decision ruled out “letting a grading failure end the run,” because one flaky model call would discard candidates already screened.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: When collection is incomplete and its retained stop reason identifies a rate limit, the result is marked rate-limited while remaining incomplete and preserving that reason. Candidate processing still proceeds; if grading one candidate raises an exception, that failure is recorded on that candidate and the loop continues with the others.
rationale: The implementation changes collection-level reporting within the decision’s active path scope. It does not introduce the ruled-out failure mode. The grading boundary still catches per-candidate failures, retains previously screened candidates, and continues the run; tests explicitly cover that behavior.
